unit.why: A short narrative, apparently a parenthetical note, about a circumcision at which R. Mordechai of Chernobyl was sandak and R. Avraham was mohel, and about R. Avraham's awe-struck dropping of the knife.
unit.boundary_note: text breaks off mid-sentence in R. Avraham's answer; the story likely continues beyond this division

stories.end_quote: בעיני יפלא האיך (אפשרי לשאול שאלה כזו
stories.summary_en: As heard from the narrator's master: at a circumcision where R. Mordechai of Chernobyl was sandak, the mohel R. Avraham recited the blessing in such great awe that the knife fell from his hand, and when R. Mordechai asked him about this awe he answered that he wondered how one could even ask such a question.
